recent_excerpts: Boston Scientific disclosed a cyberattack disrupting order processing and shipments of pacemakers and stents.
Unit 42's NOVA system uncovered 14,090 novel vulnerabilities across 3,915 OSS projects in two months — 40% high or critical severity — collapsing the patch window to near zero.
XCSSET v40, a macOS malware targeting Xcode developers, has resurfaced with 17 modules, including a Chrome hijacking backdoor and Telegram trojanizer, after months of dormancy.
